name: Volrath, the Shapestealer
oracle_text:
At the beginning of combat on your turn, put a -1/-1 counter on up to one target creature.
{1}: Until your next turn, Volrath becomes a copy of target creature with a counter on it, except it's 7/5 and it has this ability.
blocked_sentences: {1}: Until your next turn, Volrath becomes a copy of target creature with a counter on it, except it's 7/5 and it has this ability.

needs.what: a `duration: "until_your_next_turn"` on the `become_copy` op: the in-place copy effect (with its except_ power/toughness and keep_abilities) persists through the end of this turn and opponents' turns, and is cleared when the effect controller's next turn begins (611.2b), not at cleanup
needs.why_existing_wont_do: op_become_copy only distinguishes `permanent` from everything else: any other duration sets `copying_until_eot`, which `clear_until_eot` wipes at this turn's cleanup, so the copy would end too early; `permanent` never ends. No op reverts a copy effect, so a `delayed_trigger` with `until_your_next_turn` cannot end a permanent copy either. The rest of the line is expressible (target selector `has_counters: true`, except_ {power: 7, toughness: 5, keep_abilities: [1]}), and the begin_combat trigger line is expressible too
